items.text: At the end of 2025, Edward Jones had $2.5 trillion in client assets under care (AUC).
items.quote: The Partnership ended the year with a 14% increase in client AUC to $2.5 trillion, including $1.1 trillion of advisory programs AUC.

items.text: At the end of 2025, $1.1 trillion of Edward Jones' client AUC was in advisory programs.
items.quote: including $1.1 trillion of advisory programs AUC

items.text: At the end of the first quarter of 2026, Edward Jones had $2.4 trillion of AUC, including $1.1 trillion of advisory programs AUC.
items.quote: The Partnership ended the first quarter of 2026 with $2.4 trillion of assets under care ("AUC"), including $1.1 trillion of advisory programs AUC.

items.text: At the end of the first quarter of 2026, $1.1 trillion of Edward Jones' AUC was in advisory programs.
items.quote: including $1.1 trillion of advisory programs AUC

items.text: At the end of the second quarter of 2026, Edward Jones had $2.6 trillion of AUC, including $1.2 trillion of advisory programs AUC.
items.quote: The Partnership ended the second quarter of 2026 with $2.6 trillion of assets under care ("AUC"), including $1.2 trillion of advisory programs AUC.

items.text: At the end of the second quarter of 2026, $1.2 trillion of Edward Jones' AUC was in advisory programs.
items.quote: including $1.2 trillion of advisory programs AUC

items.text: At the end of the second quarter of 2025, Edward Jones had $2,306 billion in client assets under care.
At the end of the second quarter of 2025, $931 billion of Edward Jones' client assets under care was in advisory programs.
In 2025, Edward Jones' average advisory programs AUC was $973 billion.
In 2025, Edward Jones' average AUC of mutual fund assets held outside of advisory programs was $701 billion (a mutual-fund-only portion of non-advisory assets).
